Name: Flowery Tools
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: Unique flower patterns burst from your tools when you use them!
Description:
Flowery Tools
This mod makes unique flower patterns burst from your tools when you use them.

*   Works in multiplayer: your friends will also see the flowers! You can disable this if you want - edit the config.json and set LocalOnly from false to true.

*   Compatible with Fast Animations (as long as you don't use a crazy high multiplier)!

*   See the tools it affects and what it looks like here: https://imgur.com/a/NGmbhVr or see images section. A few examples are below.
Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
